concepts.gloss_en: The Aramaic Targum / Targum-language (leshon Targum), a mixture of good and evil like the Tree of Knowledge, through which Holy Tongue is built up

members.note: definite article on the same mass-noun language; same referent — 'the Targum' through which leshon hakodesh is built (same lm1:19 context, e.g. עַל־יְדֵי הַתַּרְגּוּם עִקַּר בִּנְיָנָהּ). Not an archetype/role noun, so article does not shift the concept
